The standalone checker successfully performed 201 exact finite assertions, which are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact face enumerator resolves all intermediate ranks for a naturally arising all-dimensional family whose vertex Pell sequence and linear facet count were previously known. It yields an all-dimension rational generating function, a natural path-matching gamma interpretation, and an explicit distinct-negative-zero spectrum stronger than broad positivity results. These invariants are directly motivated by the geometric interpolation and support enumeration and asymptotic investigations without arbitrary parameter slicing.
